cards.mood: The track establishes an ominous and unsettling atmosphere from the outset, maintaining a consistent sense of dread through the verses.
cards.palette: A heavily distorted, growling 808-style sub-bass synth serves as the harmonic and rhythmic anchor, present from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch like fingers reaching for the dusty floor
The clock is ticking backwards behind a heavy iron door
Every artifact is breathing in this hollow, haunted space
A distorted mask of memory on every weathered face
He watches from the corner with a calculated, steady stare
Twisting every whispered word until the truth is stripped and bare
The air is thick with secrets that the daylight cannot hold
A labyrinth of secrets waiting for the inner mind to fold
[Chorus]
Caught inside the web of a closing design
Walking on the edge where the shadows entwine
No escape from the weight of the silent decree
Locked inside the grip of the truth that sets free
[Verse]
The workshop hums with energy, a rhythmic, pulsing beat
He weaves the tangled threads of life until the ends meet
One move is calculated, one glance is sharp and cold
A story in the making, a narrative of power told
The walls are closing inward like a tightening iron vise
Lost within the maze of his elaborate, dark advice
The ceiling drips with heavy thoughts like rain upon the stone
He claims the throne of every thought he calls his own
[Chorus]
Caught inside the web of a closing design
Walking on the edge where the shadows entwine
No escape from the weight of the silent decree
Locked inside the grip of the truth that sets free
[Bridge]
The walls are breathing, the floor is swaying
The truth is screaming, the silence is staying
[Chorus]
Caught inside the web of a closing design
Walking on the edge where the shadows entwine
No escape from the weight of the silent decree
Locked inside the grip of the truth that sets free
[Outro]
